Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer surfaced and implicitly carried forward an auto-generated DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet incorrectly stating that the 1927 film “Education of a Prince” originated from the United States. The agent failed to open and verify authoritative sources (e.g., the actual Wikipedia or IMDb pages) despite explicit instructions to do so, relying instead on SERP metadata. This inadequate verification introduced a false data point that could directly lead to the wrong conclusion about whether the two films are from the same country.
